fields.title: Output as variables
fields.description:
Select the columns to be converted to flow variables. For each selected column, a flow variable
is created. The name of the flow variable corresponds to the column name and the value corresponds
to the value of that column's row used in the current iteration.
fields.choicesNote: варианты появятся, когда к узлу подключена входная таблица

fields.title: If value in cell is missing
fields.description: Behavior in case of missing values in the first row or an input table with no rows.

fields.title: Default string
fields.description:
The default flow variable value for string columns in case of an empty input table
or a missing value in the first row of the input table.
